sections.name: ACTION: Two clicks at your PC: the nightly backup, and 23 GB back on C:

Dropbox undoes Claude's online-only setting within seconds (tested), so only your right-click frees the space.
steps: Type: Register the backup schedule now
File Explorer: click Dropbox in the left column
sections.recommendation: Do it today: tonight's backup runs, and C: goes from 47 to about 70 GB free.
